name: verdict-line
description: Status line with the current test's verdict: PASS/FAIL dot, PF, t-stat, reality-check/SPA p, n, failed gates and age, read from ~/.claude/verdict/latest.json (schema verdict/1 or verdict/2) that research scripts write with write_verdict() from ~/Trading/_scratch/verdict.py. The verdict is re-checked at draw time against ~/.claude/verdict/policy.json, the measured costs in bad-data.json and the experiment ledger (a TS port of verdict.py's apply_policy), so a hand-written PASS cannot show; GROSS and 'blocked: <rules>' show when they apply. Hidden after 7 days.
